preamble: The change of the voiceless velar stop [k] to the labial fricative or approximant [v] (Proto-Samic *v = [ʋ]) is a Pre-Proto-Samic cluster lenition: *k became *v before the sonorants *l, *j and *ń. It affected both inherited Uralic words (*śüklä 'wart' > *čivlē, compare Finnic *süklä) and early Baltic, Germanic and Indo-European loans adopted with *kl (*nakla 'nail' > *nāvlē > Northern Sami návli).

examples.to: Proto-Samic *čivlē > Northern Sami čivhli, Inari Sami čivle
Proto-Samic *keavlē > Northern Sami geavli, Inari Sami kevli
examples.note: The loanword was adopted with *kl and underwent the native *kl > *vl change.

examples.to: Proto-Samic *tuovlē > Northern Sami duovli, Skolt Sami tuʹvll
examples.note: Lithuanian deglis and Latvian dagla preserve the Baltic source shape.

examples.to: Proto-Samic *nāvlē > Northern Sami návli, Lule Sami návlle
